svg.title: The simultaneous centered supplier can be described explicitly; it is stronger than a two-point Gram comparison. Fix a degree cap D, an arity cap n ≥2, and a compact separated window. The actual construction provides three calibrated panels at exponents a, b, e, on one family and with the same coefficient matrices. The bounds used for a panel are its solved-column and marked insertion bounds (PC1)–(PC13), together with the rooted comparison of the entire requested finite word. Denote the common monitor by Mk, and write Hk(t) = Mt k. In the source this is bill(t, clim k); thus Hk(t)Hk(u) = Hk(t + u). A primary comparison radius is rk = akHk(a), its mesh spacing is δk = Hk(−a), and a small motion allowance is pk = Hk(c). Choose the exponents so that
